findings.mechanism: per-session setInterval heartbeat timer and gateway.sessions map entry
findings.evidence: Ran 5 waves of 20000 connections (hello, subscribe, 12 publishes, hangup) through load.js's runWorkload with forced GC between waves: sessions=0, topics=0, heapUsed flat at 3.3-3.5MB, active handles=0, RSS flat at ~123-126MB after wave 1.
findings.discriminator: Session.close() calls clearInterval(this.heartbeat) and release() deletes the map entry on socket close; after each wave sessions.size==0 and heapUsed does not grow.

findings.mechanism: router.topics Map of Sets of sessions
findings.evidence: topics.size==0 after every wave; close() unsubscribes every topic and unsubscribe deletes empty topic entries.
findings.discriminator: topics Map is empty after all sessions disconnect.

findings.evidence: Keys are a fixed set (closed_<reason> with 4-5 reasons); latency array fixed size.
findings.discriminator: Key space is bounded, not derived from client input.

findings.evidence: remember() shifts beyond RECENT_LIMIT=64; sessions are freed on disconnect anyway.
findings.discriminator: Capped at 64 entries and owned by the session.

findings.cause: test harness only; real net.Socket does not retain writes
findings.evidence: Collected with the socket after each wave (heap flat).
